text:
ravi: Heads-up: we're proposing tenant-based retention tiers for security logs (SaaS customers). Default 90d, elevated 365d for enterprise customers with contractual need. Thinking about how to express this in the SIEM export pipeline and KMS proxy behavior.

anna: Do we have contract flags in the tenant metadata? We need a reliable source of truth so exports don't accidentally keep too long.

ravi: Yes - tenant profile has `retention_level` (standard/premium/legal-hold). We'll wire exporter to read that. Need to decide: do we store separate S3 buckets per tier or use prefixes + lifecycle?

gil: Prefer single bucket + prefix + lifecycle rules per prefix. Easier to manage CMK policies and avoids bucket proliferation. But encryption keys and access policies need to be prefix-aware.

legal: Legal: if a legal hold is placed, retention must be suspended and data preserved until hold cleared. We need an API to annotate exports with `legal_hold:true` and tie to case id. Also must track who placed hold.

ravi: plan draft: exporter uses `tenant.retention_level` to select `ttl_days` (standard=90, premium=365, legal-hold=retain-until-cleared). Exports labeled with `export.labels` including `case_id` when on hold. RBAC: only `security:analyst`, `legal:holder`, and `platform:ops` can set/clear holds.

anna: KMS question: during CMK rotation we currently rewrap objects in place. If we have legal holds, rewrap must preserve hold metadata and not accidentally expire objects. Also, rewrap job needs access to all prefixes. Can we use a proxy that requests short-lived decrypt grants per prefix?

gil: yes - KMS-proxy can mint ephemeral grants scoped to alias+prefix. Flow: rewrap daemon asks proxy for grant token for prefix X for N minutes, performs rewrap, releases token. No human key material.

oncall: operational note: add a check in rotation runbook: if any `legal_hold` active for prefix, ensure rewrap token covers those keys and ensure lifecycle rules are not applied until verification.

sec-bot: ALERT TEMPLATE: create an audit event when `legal_hold` is created or removed. Must include actor, timestamp, case_id, and key_alias used at time of hold.

ravi: RBAC change: we need a cross-org access review to add `legal:holder` role. Suggest add to Q1 access review cadence. Who owns?

legal: I'll own the `legal:holder` onboarding checklist. Need training and signoff.

anna: exporter config example for clarity: 

```exporter:
  name: siem-export
  default_ttl_days: 90
  retention_map:
    standard: 90
    premium: 365
    legal-hold: INDEFINITE
  masking_profile: pii-default
  bucket_prefix_template: "logs/{tenant_id}/{retention_level}/"
  allow_snapshot_roles: ["security:analyst","legal:holder","platform:forensics"]
```

anna: question: how do we prevent external partner consumers from requesting longer snapshots?

gil: enforce at the proxy: accept snapshot requests only when token issuer is in allow_snapshot_roles; validate tenant trust level; require `signed_reason` and link to incident or case. Any request without required fields is rejected with 403.

noncall: add monitoring: a daily report of exports >90d and any snapshot requests. Generate pager if mismatch between tenant contract and retention applied.

ravi: legal hold lifecycle: create -> annotate objects (metadata flag) -> suspend lifecycle rules -> notify compliance -> when cleared, record clearance event, and optionally apply lifecycle rule with a 30d grace. All events logged to audit stream (immutable).

legal: we also need an escalation flow: only `legal:holder` + two approvers from `security:lead` or `ciso` can clear high-risk holds. Add this to onboarding doc.

sec-bot: REMINDER: rotation window for SIEM CMK scheduled at 1766100000. Ensure rewrap daemon uses KMS-proxy tokens and honors `legal_hold` markers.

ravi: next steps: 1) PR for exporter to add tenant-retention lookup + prefix template (owner: anna), 2) KMS-proxy change to issue prefix-scoped grants for rewrap (owner: gil), 3) RFC for RBAC additions and access review (owner: ravi + legal), 4) runbook update for rotations (owner: oncall).

anna: will open the PR today. I'll include unit tests that simulate legal_hold and premium tenants.

gil: I'll prototype the grant token API and post sample call. ETA 3 days.

legal: I'll draft the onboarding checklist and escalation rules.

noncall: I'll add rotation runbook steps and a pre-rotation smoke test that checks `legal_hold` registry and lifecycle suspension.

ravi: also let's add an audit alert: any export older than contract TTL without legal_hold flag -> create ticket to `security+legal`.

anna: ack. We'll include partner comms template: partners should pull by object prefix; if they need extended retention, they must file request and sign Data Processing Addendum.

ravi: thanks. If anyone spots compliance edge cases (EU data residency + retention overrides), add to the RFC. Meeting to triage tomorrow 09:30 UTC.

sec-bot: ACTION CREATED: ticket #SIEM-RET-1766 created for tenant-retention changes.

oncall: I'll be on watch during rotation window and run the smoke tests. Ping this thread for pre-rotation signoff.

ravi: closing - good plan.
